data.name: About.Subheading
data.value: The VI House is a private, invitation-first community for founders, operators and investors who take building seriously — and take the people around them just as seriously.

data.name: About.Paragraph1
data.value: We started The VI House on a simple observation: the best decisions rarely happen in a boardroom. They happen over dinner, on a walk, in the quiet conversation after the panel ends. So instead of building another conference, we built a series of small, curated rooms — real places, real people, real depth.

data.name: About.Paragraph2
data.value: Every experience is capped in size and reviewed applicant by applicant. We are not optimizing for attendance numbers — we are optimizing for the right twenty people in the right room, for long enough that trust actually forms.

data.name: About.Paragraph3
data.value: What you'll find inside is not a course, and not a networking event in the usual sense. It's a working retreat for people building serious things, hosted with the care of a home rather than the logistics of a conference.

data.name: About.Value1Body
data.value: Every application is reviewed by hand. We would rather have twenty right people than two hundred maybe-right ones.

data.name: About.Value2Body
data.value: No stage lighting, no sponsor booths. Just serious conversation, in rooms built for it.

data.name: About.Value3Body
data.value: The relationships formed here are meant to outlast the event itself — that's the actual product.

data.name: Faq.Q1
data.value: How does the application process work?

data.name: Faq.A1
data.value: You submit a short application telling us about you and what you're building. Every application is reviewed by hand — we don't use automated scoring. If approved, you'll receive a private, time-limited link to complete payment and secure your place.

data.name: Faq.A2
data.value: Most applicants hear back within a few business days. Because every application is read individually, review time can vary slightly around larger experiences.

data.name: Faq.A3
data.value: You'll be notified by email, and we'll reach out the moment a place opens up. Waitlisted applicants are not charged anything until a spot is confirmed.

data.name: Faq.Q4

data.name: Faq.A4

data.name: Faq.Q5

data.name: Faq.A5
data.value: Primarily, but we also welcome operators and investors who are genuinely engaged in building — the room is curated for fit, not job title alone.

data.name: Faq.A6

data.name: Faq.A7

These Terms & Conditions govern your use of The VI House website and your participation in any VI House experience. By applying, purchasing a ticket, or otherwise using this site, you agree to be bound by these terms.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.Body
data.value:
This Privacy Policy explains how The VI House Group Ltd. collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you apply, book an experience, or otherwise interact with this site.
What We Collect. When you apply or register, we collect the information you provide directly — name, contact details, company and professional information, and your application responses — along with technical information such as your IP address for security purposes.
How We Use It. We use your information to process your application, administer bookings and payments, send you service-related communications, and, where you've agreed, occasional updates about future experiences.
Payment Data. We never store your card details. Payments are processed directly by our third-party payment provider, which maintains its own compliance and security standards.
Sharing. We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us operate the site, such as payment processing and email delivery, and only to the extent necessary for them to provide that service.
Your Rights. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete your personal data, or to object to certain processing. You can exercise these rights by contacting us via our Contact page.
Data Retention. We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law.
Changes to This Policy. We may update this policy from time to time; the date of the latest revision is shown at the top of this page.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.Body
data.value:
This Cookie Policy explains how The VI House uses cookies and similar technologies on this website.
What Are Cookies. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function correctly and remember your preferences — for example, your selected language.
Essential Cookies. We use a small number of essential cookies required for the site to work, such as keeping you signed in and remembering your language preference. These cannot be disabled without affecting site functionality.
Analytics. We may use limited, privacy-respecting analytics to understand how the site is used, so we can improve it. Where required by law, we will ask for your consent before setting non-essential cookies.
Managing Cookies. Most browsers let you control cookies through their settings, including deleting existing cookies and blocking new ones. Blocking essential cookies may affect your ability to use parts of this site.
Changes. We may update this policy as our use of cookies changes; the date of the latest revision is shown at the top of this page.

data.name: Legal.Refund.Body
data.value:
This Refund Policy explains how cancellations and refunds are handled for VI House experiences.
Cancellations by You. Refund eligibility depends on how far in advance of the experience you cancel. Specific cancellation windows and any applicable fees are shown at checkout for each experience before you complete payment.
Cancellations by Us. If we cancel, reschedule, or relocate an experience for reasons within our control, you will be offered a full refund or a transfer to a future experience, at your choice.
Non-Refundable Circumstances. We are not able to offer refunds for failure to attend, late arrival, or voluntary early departure, except where required by law.
How Refunds Are Processed. Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method via our payment processor, and may take several business days to appear depending on your bank.
Questions. If you believe you're entitled to a refund outside these terms, contact us via our Contact page and we'll review it individually.
